challenge.defect: Store keyed records only by id and required a new ID for changed evidence, losing stable identity and exact version pinning.
challenge.resolution: Composite (id,version) identities and foreign keys throughout; version pins survive model JSON; receipts pin entity type/id/version and require exact resolution.

attempt3_changes: SQLite schema version 2 uses (id,version) primary keys for all six entities and deferred composite foreign keys for every relationship.

Segment/Claim scalar version fields, exact reference-version maps, and fact/relation/citation claim_version fields keep graph pins in serialized models; six schemas regenerated (Talk schema bytes unchanged).
EntityRef and Entity.ref represent exact typed evidence references. Store.get(...,version='1') is exact and never selects latest; Store.resolve resolves serialized pins.
PASS receipts require resolvable versioned output_refs. Same ID/new version can coexist; exact ID/version overwrites still fail and preserve prior evidence.

Regression tests cover two complete six-entity versions, old-reference preservation, all FK pin paths, absent versions, typed receipt pins, stable Talk counting, and rejection of legacy databases without rewriting them.

python3.12 - <<'PY'
import hashlib
import json
import shlex
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

base = 'fd46d76ba7ab72c1335788dbcda024ca1dcc413e'
old = json.loads(Path('evidence/c02-developer-attempt2.json').read_text())
evidence_path = 'evidence/c02-developer-attempt3.json'
allowed = set(old['changed_paths_from_exact_base']) | {evidence_path}

def run(args):
    result = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True)
    return {'command': shlex.join(args), 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr}

untracked = run(['git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '-z'])
assert untracked['exit_code'] == 0
paths = [path for path in untracked['stdout'].split('\0') if path]
assert set(paths) <= allowed, sorted(set(paths) - allowed)
checks = []
for path in paths:
    check = run(['git', 'diff', '--no-index', '--check', '--', '/dev/null', path])
    assert check['exit_code'] in (0, 1) and not check['stdout'] and not check['stderr'], check
    check['status'] = 'PASS'
    check['interpretation'] = 'Exit 1 indicates a new-file diff; zero whitespace diagnostics.'
    stat = run(['git', 'diff', '--no-index', '--stat', '--', '/dev/null', path])
    assert stat['exit_code'] in (0, 1) and not stat['stderr'], stat
    checks.extend((check, stat))
tracked = run(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', base])
assert tracked['exit_code'] == 0
changed = sorted(set(tracked['stdout'].splitlines()) | set(paths))
assert set(changed) <= allowed
artifacts = []
for path in changed:
    if path == evidence_path:
        continue
    contents = Path(path).read_bytes()
    artifacts.append({'path': path, 'bytes': len(contents), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(contents).hexdigest()})
ignored = run(['git', 'check-ignore', '.skillware/probe', 'data/probe', '.cursor/probe', '.grok/probe', '.env.probe'])
assert ignored['exit_code'] == 0 and len(ignored['stdout'].splitlines()) == 5
for package in ('ingest', 'extract', 'cluster', 'synth', 'links', 'evals'):
    assert Path('src/skillware', package, '__init__.py').is_file()
assert Path('data').is_dir() and Path('skills/.gitkeep').is_file()
print(json.dumps({'changed_paths_from_exact_base': changed, 'artifact_hashes': artifacts, 'untracked_verification': {'count': len(paths), 'whitespace_diagnostics': 0, 'checks': checks}, 'ignore_check': ignored, 'layout_check': 'PASS; six package directories, ignored data/, skills/.gitkeep exist'}, indent=2))

assumptions: A1 remains configurable local SQLite at .skillware/claims.sqlite3; all tests use disposable temporary databases.
Stable entity id identifies the same source/evidence item across versions; the pair (id,version) is immutable. Stable talk counts use talk.id, not the version pair.
A given relationship selects one exact version per stable referenced id. Exact version 1 is the documented default for Store.get; no automatic latest-version selection or pin inference occurs.
C02 is the initial scaffold contract; internal entity serialization schema_version stays 1, while SQLite storage schema version increments to 2 for the incompatible physical key layout.
C01 delivery-only limits are historical; user C02 authorization governs the scaffold and named CI workflow.
Publication-level source deduplication, recount/relabeling, downstream invalidation, real-corpus quality and production CLI adapters remain future pipeline stage work.
deviations_and_resolutions: The previous overwrite test incorrectly rejected a new version of the same stable ID. It now rejects modified bytes at the same ID/version, with added positive multiple-version and immutable-prior-version tests. No test acceptance criterion was weakened.
Required version pins extend schema fields while preserving all SPEC fields and six entity names. Generated schemas and structural synthetic tests were updated with the implementation.
SQLite schema version 1 databases are rejected without rewriting or migration. No private .skillware database was accessed.
One intermediate new-test run had 2 fixture-setup failures; corrected by isolating the intended missing-version condition. Final full suite passes all 103 tests.
Tracked git diff reports only README because the scaffold remains untracked under the no-commit/no-staging workflow. Per-file no-index checks/stats account for every untracked artifact.
